manifest.title: Bud TMP by EmbedLabs
manifest.tagline: Automated software, hardware and system testing
manifest.description: Bud TMP by EmbedLabs provides test management and execution for automated software, hardware and system testing.
manifest.changelog:
* Per-station enrolment credentials and updated Test Stations management.
* Improved run actions and Available test cases catalogue.
* Clearer API conflict and error responses.
manifest.postInstallMessage:
Open Bud at $CLOUDRON-APP-ORIGIN and create your administrator account.

The instance starts with no accounts, so the first visit shows a setup screen
that asks for your name, email address and a password. It stops being reachable
the moment the account exists — nobody else can claim the instance.

Email — invitations, password resets and address changes — works only if you
enabled the Email addon for this app. Without it, the administrator you create
here is the only way in.

manifest.title: Bud TMP by EmbedLabs
manifest.tagline: Automated software, hardware and system testing
manifest.description:
Bud TMP by EmbedLabs provides test management and execution for automated software, hardware and system testing.

Manage Test Stations and execution requests, collect results and artifacts, generate reports, and publish completed run reports to Bloom PLM. Manage users and policy groups, customize report branding, and receive run notifications.
manifest.changelog:
* Access control with groups and policies, a developer role, and separate Users and Access pages.
* Run notifications to Microsoft Teams, Slack, Discord or any JSON endpoint.
* Audit log of security-relevant events.
* Optional S3-compatible storage for run artifacts and generated reports.
* Robot Framework runs from bud-runner keep their log and report pages with the run.
* Receive Bloom report requests, notify report publishers, and publish or refuse with a reason.
* Company logo on test-run PDF reports, alongside the EmbedLabs branding.
* Saved profile pictures across user displays, with initials fallback and refresh after replacement or removal.
